Contents of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RockwellAutomation/ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools/main/README.md:
# ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools

A collection of .NET 10.0 command-line utilities and libraries for working with Rockwell Automation Studio 
5000 `.L5X` project files.

The `l5xplode` command enables you to "explode" (decompose) `.L5X` files into a structured directory of XML and text files, 
making them easier to version, diff, and review in source control systems like Git. You can also "implode" (recompose) the directory 
structure back into a valid `.L5X` file.

The `l5xgit` command contains everything l5xplode does but also additional commands to assist with importing/exporting ACD
files to/from a more git-appropriate format, and even commit / diff those changes.

## Features

- **Explode** `.L5X` files into a logical folder structure of XML and structured text files.
- **Implode** a folder structure back into a single `.L5X` file.
- **Convert** between `.L5X` and `.ACD` (binary project) formats (requires Studio 5000 Logix Designer and SDK libraries).
- **Git integration**: Commit, diff, and restore project files using Git-friendly workflows.
- **Custom serialization**: Allows for adding custom serialization formats and options.
- **Cross-platform**: Runs on Windows and Linux (limited features) with .NET 10.0.

### Prerequisites

- [.NET 10.0 SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0)
- Studio 5000 Logix Designer and the Logix Designer SDK for `.ACD` file operations

### Build

Clone the repository and build:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/RockwellAutomation/ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools.git
cd ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools
dotnet build -c Release
```

### Usage

There are two command-line tools with built-in help for commands provided.  l5xgit-exclusive commands may only function on Windows.
Some commands may be available in both utilities.

```sh
l5xplode -h
l5xgit -h
```

#### Common Commands

- **Explode an L5X file:**
  ```sh
  l5xplode explode --l5x path/to/project.L5X --dir path/to/output/dir
  ```

- **Implode a directory back to L5X:**
  ```sh
  l5xplode implode --dir path/to/output/dir --l5x path/to/project.L5X
  ```

- **Convert L5X to ACD:**
  ```sh
  l5xgit l5x2acd --l5x path/to/project.L5X --acd path/to/project.ACD
  ```

- **Commit exploded project to Git:**
  ```sh
  l5xgit commit --acd path/to/project.ACD
  ```

- **Show diff with previous commit:**
  ```sh
  l5xgit difftool --acd path/to/project.ACD
  ```

- **Restore from Git:**
  ```sh
  l5xgit restoreacd --acd path/to/project.ACD
  ```

## Dependency Check and `--unsafe-skip-dependency-check`

When an L5X file contains encrypted/encoded Add-On Instructions (AOIs) and was exported
without the `Dependencies` export option, the tools will refuse to explode it because
dependency ordering cannot be guaranteed for encoded AOIs. If you need to proceed anyway,
pass `--unsafe-skip-dependency-check` to bypass this check:

```sh
l5xplode explode --l5x path/to/project.L5X --dir path/to/output/dir --unsafe-skip-dependency-check
l5xgit commit --acd path/to/project.ACD --unsafe-skip-dependency-check
```

> **Note:** This flag is **not needed** if the L5X was exported via the **Logix Designer SDK 2.2+**
> (which always includes dependency metadata), or if the project contains **no encrypted/encoded AOIs**.

> **Warning:** Using this flag without proper dependency information means code merges may produce an L5X
> with incorrect AOI ordering, potentially causing import errors in Logix Designer.
>
> Even with this flag set, a best-effort attempt is made to preserve dependency ordering of AOIs,
> so in cases where no manual merging / removal / addition of AOIs is taking place outside
> of this tool, skipping this check should not cause import errors after the implode operation.

## Integration with Logix Designer

Some level of integration with Logix Designer can be achieved by using Custom Tools xml which is produced during the build
configured to point to the build output path.

`artifacts\bin\release\Assets\CustomToolsMenu.xml` can be copied to: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Rockwell Software\RSLogix 5000\Common\CustomToolsMenu.xml`
to install the custom tools globally within Logix Designer.

A script is provided which self-elevates to Administrator and performs the copy:

```powershell
.\Install-CustomToolsMenu.ps1
```


## Testing

End-to-end tests are written in PowerShell using [Pester](https://pester.dev/) and live under the `e2e_tests/` directory.
Tests are organized into subdirectories by tool (`l5xplode/` and `l5xgit/`).

### Prerequisites

- **Pester 5.7.1+** — install with: `Install-Module Pester -RequiredVersion 5.7.1 -Scope CurrentUser`
- **Logix Designer V38** or newer
- **Logix Designer SDK 2.2** or higher
- Build the solution first: `dotnet build -c Release`

### Running Tests

Run all tests for a tool subdirectory:

```powershell
Import-Module Pester -RequiredVersion 5.7.1 -Force
Invoke-Pester -Path .\e2e_tests\l5xplode\*.Tests.ps1 -Output Detailed
Invoke-Pester -Path .\e2e_tests\l5xgit\*.Tests.ps1 -Output Detailed
```

Run all tests across both tools:

```powershell
Invoke-Pester -Path .\e2e_tests\l5xplode.Tests.ps1, .\e2e_tests\l5xgit.Tests.ps1 -Output Detailed
```

### Debug Mode

Each test file accepts a `-Debug` switch that prints every tool invocation, its stdout/stderr,
exit codes, and pauses on assertion failures so you can inspect temp directories.

Run all l5xgit tests with debug output:

```powershell
Get-ChildItem e2e_tests\l5xgit *.ps1 | ForEach-Object { & $_.FullName -Debug }
```

> **Note:** The SDK-dependent tests (tagged `SDK`) such as `CommitRestore.roundtrip.Tests.ps1`
> require the Logix Designer SDK to be installed and will fail on machines without it.

## Project Structure

- `L5xploderLib/` – Library for exploding/imploding and serialization logic
- `L5xGitLib/` - Library for interacting with git repos.
- `L5xCommands/` – Command-line interface and command implementations
- `l5xgit/` – CLI executable exposing commands defined in L5xCommands
- `l5xplode/` – CLI executable exposing subset of commands defined in L5xCommands

## Limitations
- Source-protected content is non-human readable in XML the encoded content mutates with
  each export causing files in git to change when no source changes were made.
- If the project does not verify / export without error, it cannot be converted
  to L5X from ACD and vice-versa.
- Output formats may change and may not function in future versions
- Encoded content can cause problems with dependency resolution and AOI ordering.
  To minimize issues, either avoid encoded content in the L5X, or use Logix Designer
  V38 or newer with the LD SDK 2.2 or higher for exporting to L5X.  Exports through
  The Logix Designer GUI will not contain all of the dependency relationship metadata
  that the SDK provides, and may not preserve proper AOI ordering, potentially causing
  dependency resolution issues on reimport.

## Contributing
We are not accepting contributions at this time.

## License
Permission to modify and redistribute is granted under the terms of the MIT License.  
See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for the full license.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Copies the built CustomToolsMenu.xml to the Logix Designer common directory.

.DESCRIPTION
    This script copies artifacts\bin\Release\Assets\CustomToolsMenu.xml to
    C:\Program Files (x86)\Rockwell Software\RSLogix 5000\Common\CustomToolsMenu.xml
    so that the custom tools are available globally within Logix Designer.

    The script will self-elevate to Administrator if not already running elevated,
    because the destination is under Program Files.

.PARAMETER Configuration
    Build configuration to copy from. Defaults to 'Release'.
#>
param(
    [string]$Configuration = 'Release'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$source      = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "artifacts\bin\$Configuration\Assets\CustomToolsMenu.xml"
$destination = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Rockwell Software\RSLogix 5000\Common\CustomToolsMenu.xml'

if (-not (Test-Path $source)) {
    Write-Error "Source file not found: $source`nPlease build the solution first: dotnet build -c $Configuration"
    return
}

$isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole(
    [Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator
)

if (-not $isAdmin) {
    Write-Host 'Requesting Administrator privileges...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $psArgs = @(
        '-NoProfile'
        '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass'
        '-File', "`"$PSCommandPath`""
        '-Configuration', $Configuration
    )
    Start-Process pwsh -ArgumentList $psArgs -Verb RunAs -Wait
    return
}

$destDir = Split-Path $destination -Parent
if (-not (Test-Path $destDir)) {
    Write-Error "Logix Designer common directory not found: $destDir`nIs Logix Designer installed?"
    return
}

# Backup existing file
if (Test-Path $destination) {
    $i = 1
    while (Test-Path "$destination.bak$i") { $i++ }
    $backupPath = "$destination.bak$i"
    Move-Item -Path $destination -Destination $backupPath
    Write-Host "Backed up existing file to:`n  $backupPath" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

Copy-Item -Path $source -Destination $destination
Write-Host "Copied:`n  $source`n  -> $destination" -ForegroundColor Green

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="System.CommandLine" Version="2.0.5" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\L5xCommands\L5xCommands.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="Assets\commit.bmp">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>Always</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
    <None Include="Assets\difftool.bmp">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>Always</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
    <None Include="Assets\pull.bmp">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>Always</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
  </ItemGroup>

  <Target Name="TransformCustomToolsMenu" AfterTargets="Build">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <_ActualOutDir>$([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath('$(OutDir)'))</_ActualOutDir>
      <_SourceFile>$(ProjectDir)Assets\CustomToolsMenu.xml</_SourceFile>
      <_DestDir>$(_ActualOutDir)Assets\</_DestDir>
      <_DestFile>$(_DestDir)CustomToolsMenu.xml</_DestFile>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <MakeDir Directories="$(_DestDir)" Condition="!Exists('$(_DestDir)')" />
    <ReadLinesFromFile File="$(_SourceFile)">
      <Output TaskParameter="Lines" ItemName="CustomToolsMenuLines" />
    </ReadLinesFromFile>
    <WriteLinesToFile File="$(_DestFile)" Lines="@(CustomToolsMenuLines->Replace('@@OUTDIR@@', '$(_ActualOutDir)'))" Overwrite="true" />
  </Target>
</Project>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.Views.SettingsWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="Dependencies — AB Logix Git Manager — ACS"
        Width="720" Height="560"
        MinWidth="600" MinHeight="440"
        Background="{StaticResource SteelBrush}"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        Icon="{StaticResource AcsIcon}">

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:DependencyStatusToIconConverter  x:Key="StatusIcon"/>
        <conv:DependencyStatusToColorConverter x:Key="StatusColor"/>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter             x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ACS header -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="16,12" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
                BorderBrush="{StaticResource LineBrush}" Background="{StaticResource CardBrush}">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <Border Grid.Column="0" Padding="8,6" CornerRadius="6"
                        Background="{StaticResource SteelBrush}"
                        BorderBrush="{StaticResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="1">
                    <Image Source="{StaticResource AcsIcon}" Height="34" Width="34" Stretch="Uniform"/>
                </Border>

                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,0,0">
                    <TextBlock Text="DEPENDENCY CENTER"
                               FontFamily="{StaticResource LegendFont}"
                               FontSize="18"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource InkBrush}"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding ScanStatus}"
                               FontFamily="{StaticResource LegendFontCondensed}"
                               FontSize="10.5"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                </StackPanel>

                <Button Content="↺  RESCAN"
                        Command="{Binding RescanCommand}"
                        IsEnabled="{Binding IsScanning, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"/>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- Footer close -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="{StaticResource GraphiteBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{StaticResource PanelEdgeBrush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0"
                Padding="16,10">
            <Button Content="CLOSE" Click="Close_Click"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                    Style="{StaticResource GhostButton}" Padding="22,7"/>
        </Border>

        <!-- Content -->
        <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="16" Margin="20,18,20,18">

                <!-- ── Dependency list ── -->
                <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Padding="0">
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Dependencies}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border Padding="14,12"
                                        BorderBrush="{StaticResource LineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                        <!-- Status indicator -->
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status, Converter={StaticResource StatusIcon}}"
                                                   FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="0,1,14,0"/>
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                                           FontFamily="{StaticResource BodyFont}"
                                                           FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                                           Foreground="{StaticResource InkBrush}"
                                                           Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Version}"
                                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                                           Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0">
                                                    <TextBlock.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource Data}">
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Version}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </TextBlock.Style>
                                                </TextBlock>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status}"
                                                           FontFamily="{StaticResource LegendFontCondensed}"
                                                           FontSize="11"
                                                           Foreground="{Binding Status, Converter={StaticResource StatusColor}}"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Message}"
                                                       FontSize="11.5"
                                                       Margin="0,3,0,0">
                                                <TextBlock.Style>
                                                    <Style TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource Body}">
                                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Message}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger>
                                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                                    </Style>
                                                </TextBlock.Style>
                                            </TextBlock>
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Style="{StaticResource Caption}"
                                                       TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                                <Run Text="REQUIRED FOR: "/>
                                                <!--
                                                    Run.Text has BindsTwoWayByDefault=true; always add Mode=OneWay
                                                    when binding to a get-only property or WPF throws at startup.
                                                -->
                                                <Run Text="{Binding RequiredFor, Mode=OneWay}"/>
                                            </TextBlock>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>
                </Border>

                <!-- ── Setup actions ── -->
                <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock Text="SETUP ACTIONS" Style="{StaticResource Eyebrow}"/>
                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource Body}" Margin="0,6,0,12"
                                   Text="Download + Compile clones Rockwell's VCS tools, builds l5xgit.exe, and auto-associates that executable in app settings. Studio 5000 custom tools only work when a project is open, because Studio expands the %project_path% macro at launch."/>

                        <WrapPanel>
                            <Button Margin="0,0,8,8"
                                    Width="184"
                                    Command="{Binding InstallDotNetSdkCommand}"
                                    Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}">
                                <TextBlock Text="INSTALL .NET SDK 10"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Margin="0,0,8,8"
                                    Width="184"
                                    Command="{Binding InstallAndBuildRockwellVcsToolsCommand}"
                                    Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}">
                                <TextBlock Text="DOWNLOAD + COMPILE ROCKWELL VCS TOOLS"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Margin="0,0,8,8"
                                    Width="184"
                                    Command="{Binding InstallStudioCustomToolsMenuCommand}">
                                <Button.Style>
                                    <Style TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource NeutralButton}">
                                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsStudio5000Detected}" Value="True">
                                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                    </Style>
                                </Button.Style>
                                <TextBlock Text="ADD CUSTOM TOOLS TO STUDIO 5000"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Margin="0,0,8,8"
                                    Width="184"
                                    Click="UseExistingL5xGit_Click"
                                    IsEnabled="{Binding CanUseExistingL5xGit}"
                                    Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}">
                                <TextBlock Text="USE EXISTING L5XGIT.EXE…"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Button>
                        </WrapPanel>

                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding ActionStatus}"
                                   Style="{StaticResource Body}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>

                        <!-- Terminal readout -->
                        <Border Background="{StaticResource GraphiteBrush}" CornerRadius="5"
                                Padding="10" MinHeight="120" Margin="0,10,0,0">
                            <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                          HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                                <TextBox Text="{Binding ActionLogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                         IsReadOnly="True"
                                         Background="Transparent"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource PhosphorBrush}"
                                         FontFamily="{StaticResource DataFont}"
                                         FontSize="11.5"
                                         BorderThickness="0"
                                         TextWrapping="NoWrap"/>
                            </ScrollViewer>
                        </Border>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- ── Note ── -->
                <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource Body}" Foreground="{StaticResource FaintBrush}"
                           Text="Studio 5000 and the Logix Designer SDK are licensed vendor software. Detection uses registry keys; exact keys and version requirements are subject to change. Studio custom tools also require an open project so the %project_path% macro can resolve. Contact your Rockwell Automation vendor or IT administrator for installation guidance."/>

            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </ScrollViewer>

    </DockPanel>
</Window>

permissionRequest.newFileContents:
# AB Logix Git Manager

A Windows WPF front end for managing Allen-Bradley Logix ACD projects with Git
through Rockwell Automation's
[`l5xgit`](https://github.com/RockwellAutomation/ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)
tools.

> **Current status: pre-release scaffold.** The repository does not yet produce
> a validated GitHub Releases artifact or bundle its external tools. The
> dependency center detects tools but does not automate installation or repair.
> See the [Release acceptance criteria](plan.md#release-acceptance-criteria) in
> `plan.md` before advertising a zero-dependency release artifact.

## Planned release experience (not yet validated)

The release target is one download from GitHub Releases that starts without an
installer, an existing .NET installation, or administrator rights:

- Ship the application with its own self-contained .NET runtime.
- Prefer a self-contained, single-file Windows executable only after validating
  WPF and all required native/content files. If a literal one-file executable is
  unreliable, ship a self-extracting launcher or clearly documented portable
  package while retaining the one-download/no-install experience.
- Show each dependency as **Ready**, **Missing**, **Incompatible**,
  **Installing**, **Failed**, or **Admin Required**, with **Install Now** or
  **Repair** where automated action is legal and technically reliable.
- Prefer pinned and verified prebuilt VCS tool binaries so ordinary release
  users do not need .NET SDK 10. Building or updating those tools from source is
  a fallback/developer path, subject to redistribution and licensing review.

The bundled application runtime only starts this application; it is not the
.NET SDK needed to compile upstream tools. Studio 5000 and the Logix Designer
SDK remain licensed vendor software and may require vendor media or login,
activation, administrator approval, a reboot, or organizational IT deployment.
The application may guide or launch those steps but will not promise silent,
no-admin installation. UAC is reserved for privileged external installation or
Studio integration—not for launching the manager or using its basic functions.

See [`plan.md`](plan.md) for the canonical engineering plan, feasibility gates,
and acceptance criteria.

## Current status

Implemented:

- Add, edit, remove, and persist ACD-to-repository mappings in
  `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\config.json`.
- Write or overwrite the `<AcdName>_L5xGit.yml` sidecar before an operation.
- Invoke `l5xgit commit --acd ...`, passing the commit message on standard input.
- Invoke `git -C ... pull` then `l5xgit restoreacd --acd ...`, answering `y` to
  the overwrite prompt — **restore is aborted if `git pull` fails**.
- Validate `l5xgit.exe`, ACD file, and git repo paths before each operation with
  distinct error messages for each missing path, including when the selected
  folder exists but is not an initialized git working tree.
- Use `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` for all subprocess arguments (path-safe).
- Cancellable operations: a **✕ Cancel** button appears in the status bar during
  any in-progress commit or restore.
- Stream subprocess stdout/stderr into the application log with timestamps.
- **Settings / Dependency Center** (⚙ Settings button in the toolbar): scans for
  Git, Rockwell VCS tools, .NET SDK 10, Studio 5000, and Logix Designer SDK;
  shows each as **Ready**, **Missing**, **Incompatible**, or **Failed** with a
  version string and diagnostic message. Rescan runs automatically when Settings
  opens.
- **Setup actions in Settings**:
  - **Install .NET SDK 10** (winget-driven) for source-build workflows.
  - **Download + Compile Rockwell VCS Tools**: clones/updates Rockwell's VCS
    repo, builds `l5xgit.exe`, and automatically associates the built executable.
  - **Add Custom Tools to Studio 5000** (shown only when Studio 5000 is
    detected): copies the built `CustomToolsMenu.xml` into the Studio common
    folder with backup behavior equivalent to the upstream installer script.
    The resulting menu entry only works when a project is open in Studio 5000,
    because it relies on Studio's `%project_path%` macro.
  - **Use Existing l5xgit.exe** only when you already have a compiled executable.
- Setup warning card in the main window when `l5xgit.exe` is not yet configured.
- Settings window opens automatically on first run (when no `l5xgit.exe` path
  has been saved).
- Self-contained `win-x64` publish profile at
  `src/ABLogixGitManager/Properties/PublishProfiles/win-x64-selfcontained.pubxml`.

Not yet validated or implemented:

- Clean-machine testing of the self-contained publish artifact (required before
  release).
- Install/repair automation for Git; vendor-guided paths for Studio 5000 and the SDK.
- Bundled or verified `l5xgit`/Git binaries; provenance pinning and integrity
  checks for downloads.
- Signed release artifact, GitHub Actions release workflow, or smoke-test suite.

## Build and run (contributors only)

Use Windows with the .NET 10 SDK. End-to-end ACD operations additionally need a
compatible Studio 5000/Logix Designer SDK installation, a separately supplied
`l5xgit.exe`, and `git` on `PATH`.

```powershell
dotnet restore .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj
dotnet build   .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj -c Release
dotnet run --project .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj
```

For the current UI, click **⚙ Settings** to run the dependency scan. Then
browse to `l5xgit.exe`, save its path, and add a mapping with a friendly name,
ACD path, and Git/exploded-directory path.

To produce a self-contained executable (requires clean-machine validation before
release):

```powershell
dotnet publish .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj `
  /p:PublishProfile=win-x64-selfcontained
# Output: src\ABLogixGitManager\publish\win-x64\ABLogixGitManager.exe
```

> **Restore warning:** The existing ACD is overwritten without a manager-level
> backup prompt. Any backup behavior depends on the external `l5xgit` tool and
> has not been validated by this repository. Restore will not proceed if
> `git pull` fails.

  unreliable, ship a self-extracting launcher or clearly documented portable
  package while retaining the one-download/no-install experience.
- Show each dependency as **Ready**, **Missing**, **Incompatible**,
  **Installing**, **Failed**, or **Admin Required**, with **Install Now** or
  **Repair** where automated action is legal and technically reliable.
- Prefer pinned and verified prebuilt VCS tool binaries so ordinary release
  users do not need .NET SDK 10. Building or updating those tools from source is
  a fallback/developer path, subject to redistribution and licensing review.

The bundled application runtime only starts this application; it is not the
.NET SDK needed to compile upstream tools. Studio 5000 and the Logix Designer
SDK remain licensed vendor software and may require vendor media or login,
activation, administrator approval, a reboot, or organizational IT deployment.
The application may guide or launch those steps but will not promise silent,
no-admin installation. UAC is reserved for privileged external installation or
Studio integration—not for launching the manager or using its basic functions.

See [`plan.md`](plan.md) for the canonical engineering plan, feasibility gates,
and acceptance criteria.

## Current status

Implemented:

- Add, edit, remove, and persist ACD-to-repository mappings in
  `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\config.json`.
- Write or overwrite the `<AcdName>_L5xGit.yml` sidecar before an operation.
- Invoke `l5xgit commit --acd ...`, passing the commit message on standard input.
- Invoke `git -C ... pull` then `l5xgit restoreacd --acd ...`, answering `y` to
  the overwrite prompt — **restore is aborted if `git pull` fails**.
- Validate `l5xgit.exe`, ACD file, and git repo paths before each operation with
  distinct error messages for each missing path, including when the selected
  folder exists but is not an initialized git working tree.
- Use `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` for all subprocess arguments (path-safe).
- Cancellable operations: a **✕ Cancel** button appears in the status bar during
  any in-progress commit or restore.
- Stream subprocess stdout/stderr into the application log with timestamps.
- **Settings / Dependency Center** (⚙ Settings button in the toolbar): scans for
  Git, Rockwell VCS tools, .NET SDK 10, Studio 5000, and Logix Designer SDK;
  shows each as **Ready**, **Missing**, **Incompatible**, or **Failed** with a
  version string and diagnostic message. Rescan runs automatically when Settings
  opens.
- **Setup actions in Settings**:
  - **Install .NET SDK 10** (winget-driven) for source-build workflows.
  - **Download + Compile Rockwell VCS Tools**: clones/updates Rockwell's VCS
    repo, builds `l5xgit.exe`, and automatically associates the built executable.
  - **Add Custom Tools to Studio 5000** (shown only when Studio 5000 is
    detected): copies the built `CustomToolsMenu.xml` into the Studio common
    folder with backup behavior equivalent to the upstream installer script.
    The resulting menu entry only works when a project is open in Studio 5000,
    because it relies on Studio's `%project_path%` macro.
  - **Use Existing l5xgit.exe** only when you already have a compiled executable.
- Setup warning card in the main window when `l5xgit.exe` is not yet configured.
- Settings window opens automatically on first run (when no `l5xgit.exe` path
  has been saved).
- Self-contained `win-x64` publish profile at
  `src/ABLogixGitManager/Properties/PublishProfiles/win-x64-selfcontained.pubxml`.

Not yet validated or implemented:

- Clean-machine testing of the self-contained publish artifact (required before
  release).
- Install/repair automation for Git; vendor-guided paths for Studio 5000 and the SDK.
- Bundled or verified `l5xgit`/Git binaries; provenance pinning and integrity
  checks for downloads.
- Signed release artifact, GitHub Actions release workflow, or smoke-test suite.

## Build and run (contributors only)

Use Windows with the .NET 10 SDK. End-to-end ACD operations additionally need a
compatible Studio 5000/Logix Designer SDK installation, a separately supplied
`l5xgit.exe`, and `git` on `PATH`.

```powershell
dotnet restore .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj
dotnet build   .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj -c Release
dotnet run --project .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj
```

For the current UI, click **⚙ Settings** to run the dependency scan. Then
browse to `l5xgit.exe`, save its path, and add a mapping with a friendly name,
ACD path, and Git/exploded-directory path.

To produce a self-contained executable (requires clean-machine validation before
release):

```powershell
dotnet publish .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj `
  /p:PublishProfile=win-x64-selfcontained
# Output: src\ABLogixGitManager\publish\win-x64\ABLogixGitManager.exe
```

> **Restore warning:** The existing ACD is overwritten without a manager-level
> backup prompt. Any backup behavior depends on the external `l5xgit` tool and
> has not been validated by this repository. Restore will not proceed if
> `git pull` fails.

data.content:
This can be resolved; I wouldn’t remove the Studio 5000 controls.

What’s happening: the custom tool depends on Studio expanding `%project_path%`. If no project is open, Studio throws that macro error before `l5xgit.exe` even starts.

I updated the UI/docs to make that limitation explicit in [SettingsWindow.xaml](C:/Users/MitchellLandreth/Git-Local/AB-Logix-Git/src/ABLogixGitManager/Views/SettingsWindow.xaml) and [README.md](C:/Users/MitchellLandreth/Git-Local/AB-Logix-Git/README.md).

Verification:
- `dotnet build .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj -c Debug -p:OutputPath="C:\Users\MitchellLandreth\Git-Local\AB-Logix-Git\temp-build\debug\"` ✅

Residual risk: the Studio menu still requires an open project; that part is controlled by Studio, not this app.
